requirement: This code should implement a PID controller function block that calculates control output (CO) based on set point (SP), process variable (PV), and PID constants (Kc, Ti, Td). It should handle inputs such as SP, PV, Kc (proportional gain), Ti (integral time), Td (derivative time), SampleTime (interval between updates), and output limits (LowerLimit, UpperLimit). The function block should prevent division by zero by setting Ti to 1 if it is zero. It should update the PID parameters only if the current time minus the last update time exceeds SampleTime. The proportional term (CO_P) is calculated as Kc multiplied by the error (SP - PV). The integral term (CO_I) is updated by adding the product of the inverse of Ti, CO_P, and the time difference in seconds (delta_t), and it is clamped between LowerLimit and UpperLimit to prevent integral wind-up. The derivative term (CO_D) is calculated based on the rate of change of PV, and not the error, to avoid spikes in output. The total control output (CO) is the sum of CO_P, CO_I, and CO_D, and is also clamped between the specified output limits. The function block should update the last process variable and the last update time at the end of each calculation cycle.
requirement_cn: 该代码应实现一个 PID 控制器功能块，根据设定点（SP）、过程变量（PV）和 PID 常数（Kc, Ti, Td）计算控制输出（CO）。它应处理输入如 SP、PV、Kc（比例增益）、Ti（积分时间）、Td（微分时间）、SampleTime（更新间隔）和输出限制（LowerLimit, UpperLimit）。功能块应通过将 Ti 设为 1 来防止除以零的情况，如果 Ti 为零。只有当当前时间减去上次更新时间超过 SampleTime 时，才应更新 PID 参数。比例项（CO_P）计算为 Kc 乘以误差（SP - PV）。积分项（CO_I）通过添加 Ti 的倒数、CO_P 和以秒为单位的时间差（delta_t）的乘积来更新，并且在 LowerLimit 和 UpperLimit 之间进行限制，以防止积分饱和。微分项（CO_D）基于 PV 的变化率而非误差计算，以避免输出峰值。总控制输出（CO）是 CO_P、CO_I 和 CO_D 的总和，也在指定的输出限制之间进行限制。功能块应在每个计算周期结束时更新上次过程变量和上次更新时间。
